description:
Paircast is an invite-only private cloud player for synchronized playback. Videos come from the private library your self-hosted server connects to your own storage. There is no public catalog, and the app does not distribute films or TV shows.

Synced playback
Create a room and share an invite link. After friends join, play, pause, and playback position stay in sync among invited members.

Chat while you watch
Send text messages in the room. Touch and hold a message to block the sender or file a report. Chat is visible only to invited members.

Subtitles
Load embedded subtitles from the video, sidecar files stored next to the movie, or online subtitle search when your server enables it.

Your storage and account
You only enter the address of a self-hosted GO-IM server. Its admin sets up the media library. Sign up with your email when the server allows it, or sign in with an account the admin created. Your session token stays in the on-device Keychain. You can delete your account from the Me screen.

Paircast is for friends who already have lawful private media and want to watch together from a distance.
promotionalText: Use your own cloud storage to watch in sync with invited friends, and chat while you watch.
whatsNew:
Paircast 2.1 moves library setup to the server.
- Service Configuration only needs the server address; no more storage keys or subtitle / TMDB tokens in the app
- Videos, subtitles, posters, and stickers come from the server
- Switch between sources in the Library when the server has more than one
- Members who join later automatically load subtitles the host shared
- Sign up with your email (the server admin can turn this off); Delete Account now deletes the account on the server
- Service Configuration links to a new server deployment guide; config sharing and import are removed
